engine: native Windows Podman with local Linux guest
caveats: One already-running, explicitly owned guest and one current desktop scene; timings depend on scene, load and display size.
Commands were timed inside the guest, excluding Podman exec startup, Windows SSH forwarding, CLI authorization and desktop IPC.
The authenticated HTTP samples use the actual guest worker over guest loopback. No model, input, control transfer or container lifecycle action was performed.
Screenshot bytes, allocation identifiers, authorization tokens and screen content were discarded; only durations and byte counts are retained.
These measurements are diagnostics, not a latency threshold test. No PNG setting or worker code was changed.
